title: 第7章 灭族之恨第8章 报仇开始前往齐国
slug: 签到大帝修为开局收下禁忌剑体
content_zh:
“师尊找我。”
他急忙起身，跳下床，走出洞府。
这才发现已经是三天后了。
此时天已经微微亮，旭日东升，霞光万道。
火红的太阳的拨开浅薄的云雾，千丝万缕耀眼满天的光芒朝着万物倾斜而下。
陆玄合催动灵力，脚下一股出现一股无形之力托起他的身子，化作一道流光前往后山。
后山，秦天阳还是老样子，躺在那张竹制躺椅上，闭目养神。
“弟子拜见师尊！”
陆玄合来到秦天阳身旁，恭声道。
秦天阳睁开双眸，双眸中好似有星河流转，万物生灭。
他看向陆玄合，道：“此次唤你前来，是为了你。”
“为了我？”
陆玄合神情疑惑，他觉得自己现在很好，不仅修为恢复，实力更进一截，而且还获得师尊赐予的无上功法与大帝道兵，正欲询问秦天阳。
突然想到了什么，猛地一激灵，瞳孔猛缩，身躯颤抖，不可思议地开口询问：“师尊您唤弟子前来，难道是为了弟子的灭族之仇吗？”
他丝毫不震惊师尊为什么知道自己的事，因为他知道师尊实力深不可测，知天知地。
他只是震惊于师尊竟会亲自过问此事，关心自己。
这如何不让他感动！
“师尊，弟子并无大碍，有劳师尊挂念了！”
陆玄合眼角似有晶莹泪光闪烁，然而他并不愿给师尊添麻烦。
“哼！

乖徒儿，你这可就大错特错了！”
“一日为师，终生为父。
我既已知晓你的过往，又岂能在一旁作壁上观？若真如此，我还是一个称职的师父吗？”
“若是旁人知晓此事，虽不敢明着说，岂不暗中骂死我？更何况你师父我本就是个热心肠之人，平时路见不平，都会拔刀相助，此乃家常便饭。”
“再者，若不帮你报仇雪恨，你心境难臻圆满，势必会对你的修炼造成阻碍。
禁忌剑体的问题我已告知于你，当你在修炼之途上举步维艰时，内心便会愈发焦急。
如此一来，你就越有可能走火入魔，难道你想重蹈覆辙吗？”
秦天阳起身，来到悬崖边，他极目远眺，凝视着远方的景色。
陆玄合闻之，心中涌起一股暖流，遂不再推拒，深深地鞠了一躬，道：“弟子明白了。
请问师尊，我们什么时候动身？”
“啊？动身？去哪？”
秦天阳身躯一抖，好不容易维持起来的高深形象瞬间破碎。
眼中闪过一丝尴尬，开口道：“你真把为师当成神仙了？为师虽能窥得天机，但能知道你的名字以及模糊的过去，已是极限了。”
content_en:
"Master is looking for me."
He quickly stood up, jumped out of bed, and walked out of the cave.
Only then did I realize that it was already three days later.
At this time, the sky was already slightly brighter, and the rising sun was rising in the east with thousands of rays of light.
The fiery red sun pushed aside the shallow clouds and mist, and thousands of dazzling rays of light slanted down towards everything in the sky.
Lu Xuanhe activated his spiritual power, and an invisible force appeared under his feet to lift his body, turning into a stream of light and heading towards the back mountain.
In the back mountain, Qin Tianyang was still the same as before, lying on the bamboo couch, closing his eyes and relaxing.
"Disciple pays homage to Master!"
Lu Xuanhe came to Qin Tianyang's side and said respectfully.
Qin Tianyang opened his eyes, and there seemed to be stars flowing in his eyes, and everything was coming and going.
He looked at Lu Xuanhe and said, "I'm calling you here this time because of you."
"For me?"
Lu Xuanhe looked puzzled. He felt that he was very good now. Not only had his cultivation level recovered and his strength improved, but he had also received the supreme martial arts and emperor's Taoist weapons from his master. He was about to ask Qin Tianyang.
Suddenly something occurred to him, his spirit suddenly agitated, his pupils shrank sharply, his body trembled, and he asked in disbelief: "Master, are you calling this disciple to come here for the sake of revenge for the annihilation of the disciple's clan?"
He was not shocked at all why his master knew about him, because he knew that his master's strength was unfathomable and he knew everything about heaven and earth.
He was just shocked that his master would personally intervene in this matter and care about him.
How could this not move him!
"Master, my disciple is fine. I'm sorry, Master, I'm sorry!"
There seemed to be sparkling tears in the corners of Lu Xuanhe's eyes, but he did not want to cause trouble to his master.
"Hmph!
My dear disciple, you are absolutely wrong! "
“Once a teacher, always a father.
Since I already know your past, how can I stand aside and watch? If this is the case, am I still a competent master? "
"If others know about this, even if they don't dare to say it openly, wouldn't they secretly curse me to death? What's more, your master and I are a warm-hearted person. When we see injustice on the road, we will draw a sword to help. This is a common occurrence."
"Furthermore, if I don't help you avenge your hatred, it will be difficult for you to achieve a perfect state of mind, which will definitely hinder your cultivation.
I have told you about the forbidden sword body. When you are struggling on the path of cultivation, you will become more and more anxious.
In this way, you are more likely to go crazy. Do you want to make the same mistakes again? "
Qin Tianyang stood up and came to the edge of the cliff. He looked far into the distance and stared at the distant scenery.
When Lu Xuanhe heard this, a warm current surged in his heart, and he no longer refused, bowed deeply and said, "Disciple understands.
Excuse me, Master, when will we set off? "
"Huh? Leaving? Where to go?"
Qin Tianyang's body trembled, and the profound image he had managed to maintain was instantly shattered.
A trace of embarrassment flashed in his eyes, and he said, "Do you really think that my master is a god? Although my master can see the secrets of heaven, the limit of knowing your name and vague past is already the limit."
